persistence_scaled_error_horizon_train.formula: mean(|prediction - target|) over the evaluation rows / mean(|Y[t+h] - Y[t]|) over the train origins
persistence_scaled_error_horizon_train.denominator_origin: the train origins of THIS run, never validation or test
persistence_scaled_error_horizon_train.m: not a seasonal period: the horizon h=60 steps
persistence_scaled_error_horizon_train.gaps: train origins are the admissible ones; nothing is interpolated

conventional_mase_m1_train_slice.formula: MAE / mean(|Y[t] - Y[t-1]|) over the consumed train slice
conventional_mase_m1_train_slice.gaps: non-finite consecutive pairs are EXCLUDED and counted, never closed up

conventional_mase_m1440_train_slice.formula: MAE / mean(|Y[t] - Y[t-m]|) over the consumed train slice
conventional_mase_m1440_train_slice.justification: one day at one-minute sampling: household load has a daily cycle, which is an independent seasonal ground and NOT the horizon
conventional_mase_m1440_train_slice.gaps: non-finite seasonal pairs are EXCLUDED and counted, never closed up

local_report_check.rule: the exact difference is preserved; a mismatch is reported, never averaged away

legacy_summary.scope: PUBLISHED_ROUNDED_SUMMARIES_ONLY; scale/row identity and producing configuration not independently reconstructed
